1. **`scene.ts`, the crowd.**

     ```ts
     for (const extra of recipe.crowd ?? []) {
       if (extra.layer !== layer) continue;
       for (const shape of drawFigure(extra, rng)) out.push({ ...shape, layer });
     }
     ```
     A recipe with no crowd draws no extra values, so the proofs stay unchanged.

## Risks

- **A normal picture or a repaint moving.** Only the `#alt` seed reads an alt recipe (`sceneRecipeOf`, unchanged), and the normal recipe files stay untouched. R3401000's tests catch any change.

- **The 0.6 share.** Meditative's pale paper makes this the hardest rule to meet. Measure and retune; never lower the constant.
- **Gold or bytes.** A part's default paint can fall in the gold window, or high counts can push past the byte ceiling. The tests name the part: repaint it or drop a count.
- **Presentation only** (CLAUDE.md rule 7). The recipes are static data read by card id, so there is no hidden-information or determinism risk. `card-versions.cy.tsx` checks `meditative-042`, whose Alt art now only differs more from its normal one.

## Goal

A dungeon run left half-played across a card patch picks up where it stood, folding and playing on the catalog version it started on. A run whose version this build no longer carries, or whose log no longer folds, settles once as lost (§15.8's abandon rule), banks the extractions it had stored (filtered to ids the current content still knows), and the start screen says so in one line instead of dropping it silently. One ruling, `R3496000`, covers the versioned fold, the lost-but-banked end, and what a fight under the current catalog does with removed cards.

## State

All plan steps are built. Done: `spec/rulings/R3497000.md`, `spec/pending/3497.md`, §10.10/§10.11 sentences, `game/visibility.ts`, `Game.tsx` drain props + effects, `DuosBoard.tsx` pass-through, `drainWhenHidden` in `match.tsx` and `WatchRoute.tsx`, `director.ts` turn-start keep, `Game.hiddenDrain.test.tsx` (3 tests) + `director.test.ts` R3497000 test. Verified: hiddenDrain 3 passed, director 54 passed, Game.test 32 passed, typecheck clean, `cargo fmt --check` clean. Left: nothing; `cargo jackioh spec check` passed (1875 rulings, 4845 proofs, 60274 citations, ok). No dead ends; no departures from the plan except `turnCue` typed as `Extract<SoundCue, { kind: "sfx" }>` so `turnCue.id` typechecks.

## Log
(earlier lines of the log were cut here)
.squishy/`, `bot/`, chat files, practice/dungeon/replay routes, `crates/`, `e2e/`. Governing spec: §10.10 client rendering, §10.11 Timing (§11 ruling per CLAUDE.md rule 3).

## Steps

1. Write `spec/rulings/R3497000.md`: front matter `id: R3497000`, title `Hidden tabs drain the animation queue and flushed bursts keep the turn-start cue`, `cards: "§10.10, §10.11"`, `proven_in` listing `apps/web/src/game/Game.hiddenDrain.test.tsx` and `apps/web/src/audio/director.test.ts`. Body: Hearthstone has no hidden-tab client, so the spec did not decide; the client drains the queue while hidden, shows the newest view at once, keeps the full game log, and always sends the viewer's own turn-start cue in a flushed burst.
2. Write `spec/pending/3497.md`: one paragraph in the style of `11-rulings.md`, `**[[R3497000]] … (issue #3497, 2026-11-09)**: …`, naming what it decided and rejecting always-animating and dropping the turn-start cue.
3. Edit `spec/10-engine-guide.md`: append to the §10.10 rendering flow that on an online board, while the page is hidden, the board drains its animation queue and shows the newest view at once while the game log still lists every event `[[R3497000]]`; append to the §10.11 Timing bullet that a flushed burst still sends the viewer's own turn-start cue `[[R3497000]]`.
4. Create `apps/web/src/game/visibility.ts`: export `defaultVisibility(): FxVisibility` (import the type from `../fx/types.ts`), copying `FxLayer.tsx:98-106` exactly (`document.hidden === true`, `visibilitychange` subscribe/unsubscribe). Rejected: reusing `usePageVisible` from `cards/motionSlots.ts`, which reads `document` directly and is not injectable.
5. Edit `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx`: add props `drainWhenHidden?: boolean` (default `false`) and `visibility?: FxVisibility`; memoize a fallback `useMemo(() => defaultVisibility(), [])` and use `source = visibility ?? fallback`. In the view-feed layout effect after `runner.enqueue(fresh, previous)` (line 623), add `if (drainWhenHidden && !silent && source.hidden()) runner.drain();` before the `runner.idle()` check; add `drainWhenHidden` and `source` to its deps. Add an effect subscribing to `source` that calls `runner.drain()` when a notification arrives with `!source.hidden() && drainWhenHidden && !silent && !runner.idle()`; return the unsubscribe. Enqueue-then-drain (not skip-enqueue) so the `drain` signal still reaches `FxLayer`, the director still owes then flushes on idle, and `onSettled` sets `shown`. Do not touch `lingering`, hit-stop, chat, or the reduced-motion branch.
6. Edit `apps/web/src/duos/DuosBoard.tsx`: add prop `drainWhenHidden?: boolean`; pass `drainWhenHidden={drainWhenHidden ?? !replay}` to the two own-duel `Game`s (lines 470, 528) only; the `silent` teammate board and replay boards without the prop never drain.
7. Edit `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`: pass `drainWhenHidden` to the live `<Game>` (line 458). Edit `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx`: pass `drainWhenHidden` to the live-watch `<Game>` (line 397) and to the coop `<DuosBoard>` (line 388). Leave `practice.tsx`, `FightScreen.tsx`, opened replays, and the `silent` board alone.
8. Edit `apps/web/src/audio/director.ts` `flush()`: mirror the `endCue` pattern for the turn start. In the items loop add `else if` collecting `turnCue`: a cue with `cue.kind === "sfx"`, `cue.id === "turnStart"`, `item.event.type === "turnStarted"`, and `item.event.player === item.view.viewer`, keeping the last such cue. After the loop add `if (turnCue !== null) ids.add(turnCue.id);` beside the `endCue` reservation; after `const kept = unique.slice(...)` add `if (turnCue !== null && !kept.includes(turnCue)) kept.push(turnCue);` before the `endCue` push. Decision: last viewer-own turn start wins (the cue that matters when your clock runs); opponent turn starts stay capped as today. Audibility while actually hidden depends on browser autoplay policy; the guarantee is the cue is sent.
9. Add `apps/web/src/game/Game.hiddenDrain.test.tsx` (fake timers; inject a hand-driven `{ hidden, subscribe }` source, never `document`): hidden source + `drainWhenHidden` + long batch rerender shows the newest view at once with End turn enabled and no `animation-queue` testid; visible-then-queued then notified-visible drains at once; without the prop (and with `replay`) a hidden rerender still holds moves back until timers advance.
10. Add to `apps/web/src/audio/director.test.ts` following the existing `rig()`/`withEvents` style: feed views whose batch holds more than `FLUSH_MAX_SFX` distinct sfx plus a final viewer `turnStarted`, start no entries, call `onIdle()`, and assert a `turnStart` sfx with `mine: true` was sent.
11. Run: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Game.hiddenDrain.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Game.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/director.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/game/Game.hiddenDrain.test.tsx`: `it("R3497000 a hidden board shows a new view's long batch at once with End turn enabled")`; `it("R3497000 a tab that turns visible with steps queued shows the newest view at once")`; `it("R3497000 a board without drainWhenHidden, a replay, or a visible tab behaves as before")`. Assert `screen.getByTestId("end-turn")` enabled state and `animation-queue` presence without advancing timers, using the START/HIT fixtures from `Game.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/audio/director.test.ts`: `it("R3497000 a flushed burst ending with the seat's turn start still sends the turn-start cue")`. Assert the sink holds `{ kind: "sfx", id: "turnStart" }` after `onIdle()` on a capped burst.
- Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Game.hiddenDrain.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Game.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/director.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] Hidden online board shows a new view's long batch at once with End turn enabled.
- [ ] Becoming visible with steps queued shows the newest view at once.
- [ ] Visible tab unchanged; existing animation tests pass unmodified.
- [ ] Flushed burst ending with the seat's turn start sends the turn-start cue.
- [ ] Practice, dungeon, and opened-replay boards never drain when hidden.
- [ ] `Game.hiddenDrain.test.tsx`, `Game.test.tsx`, `director.test.ts`, typecheck, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` all pass.

## Risks

- Throttled-timer tests: fake timers plus an injected source keep the new tests deterministic; no test touches real `document.visibilityState` except via the existing `setVisibility` helper, and the new tests prefer injection.
- `drain()` also fires `onSettled` → `setShown(latest)`, which is exactly what enables `legal`; the `drain` signal clears `FxLayer`/`AuraLayer` state as the existing hand-over drain does, so no new visual path is invented.
- Reduced-motion bursts run synchronously with nothing queued, so `drain()` is a harmless no-op there; the drain leaves reduced-motion, showcase, and chat paths untouched.
- Log completeness: draining skips animation entries, never events; the game log joins view windows independently of the queue.

## Open questions

None.

- [ ] The replay folds run one at a time for 1v1 and Duos together.
- [ ] A wait past `REPLAY_FOLD_WAIT_MS` is a 429 with `retryAfterMs`.
- [ ] Concurrent opens of one match fold once.
- [ ] A claimed but unsettled seed counts toward `PRACTICE_SEEDS_OPEN_MAX` in both stores, stops counting at the seed's lifetime, and a settle frees the slot.
- [ ] The sweep skips a claim being settled.
- [ ] Both rulings, the amended notes, §9.8, §14.8, `spec/pending/3500.md` and the README are written.

## Risks

- **Permit lifetime.** The permit must move into the blocking closure, not the async fn. Otherwise a dropped request frees the permit while the fold still runs.
- **Dropped first request.** If the first request of a match is dropped mid-fold, its result is lost and the next open folds again. It still waits for the permit, so it is bounded. Note this in R3500000.
- **Flight cleanup.** `strong_count <= 2` is only valid because clones are taken under the `flights` lock. Keep that lock's scope tight, with no `.await` while it is held. Clippy's `await_holding_lock` would flag it.
- **Unavoidable behaviour change.** A claim in flight now holds a seed slot. A deliberate burst is refused as 409 (the message is unchanged), and an honest player's single claim is unaffected.
- **Postgres.** The count is an edit to a query, so the Docker suite proves it. The fake and Postgres definitions must match: `claim is not null and settled_at is null`.
- **Sweep skip.** The skip is per process. During a deploy handover two processes could still both settle a claim, and `economy_practice_seed_settle`'s "only where unmarked" already makes the pay land once.
- **Duos wiring.** The Duos permit use is covered by the shared `open` tests and the existing Duos replay tests. Review it by reading the diff.
- **Contracts.** The server README's route table is the contract and must change with the behaviour. Cached pages, the per-account `REPLAY_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE` limit and seat filtering (CLAUDE.md rule 7) are untouched.

## Open questions

None. The three values (1, 5 s, 2 s) are chosen and can be retuned later in `config.rs`.

## Risks

- **Stats mock.** `DungeonStats.test.tsx` mocks `../store.ts` entirely, so without `contentOf` in the factory vitest throws "no export defined". Step 11 adds it.
- **Frozen CSS counts.** `spacing.test.ts` and `surfaces.test.ts` freeze raw-length counts per sheet, and `run.css` is one of them. Keeping the panel in the new sheet with tokens, and adding only `margin: 0` to `run.css`, avoids breaking them.
- **i18n literals.** `t("…")` literals must exist in `zh-CN.json` (the `i18n` test), and keys with `{token}` must keep the same tokens in the Chinese.
- **Emoji.** `dungeon/noEmoji.test.ts` bans emoji under `dungeon/`, so use no glyph in the button.
- **Text close buttons.** `dialogs.test.ts` bans a text "Close" button, so the ✕ is the only close.
- **Engine not loaded.** `contentOf()` throws if the engine is not loaded. The stats route is inside `EngineGate` and tests load it in `test/setup.ts`, so this is safe.
- **No rule enforcement.** The panel reads `run` and `content` and sends nothing to the run (rule 7).

## Open questions

None blocks the build. Decisions the builder records:

- **Fight tray.** The issue's "Why" says curses never show in a fight, but its proposal and "Where it lands" do not touch the fight tray, so `fight/` stays unchanged. A person may want curses in the tray later.
- **Seed first in the panel.** The issue lists it last, but it goes first so a long deck does not push it out of view on a phone.
- **Curse names on the stats page.** They come from the current compiled content, not from the content the run was played on, because the record stores only ids. A dropped id shows as the id.
- **`contentOf` is exported and called inside `RunDetails`.** The alternative was a second `runContent()` parse through the wasm bindings, which would make the test depend on the placeholder curses that the designer's content will replace.
- **Seed on the run-over screen is plain text.** There is no copy button there, because the HUD's panel is present on that screen.

      - Hearthstone has no run timer, so it follows the roguelike convention of time played.
      - It counts only while the Dungeon page is open and the browser page is shown.
      - It is banked on each save, on hide, on `pagehide` and on leaving the page.

      - A run kept before this change starts at load.

      - The on-screen timer shows the same total.

## Tests

**`store.test.ts`**

Add `import { resetVisibility, setVisibility } from "../test/setup.ts"`, call `resetVisibility()` in `afterEach`, and add `advance(ms) = vi.setSystemTime(Date.now() + ms)`. New `describe("R3502000 a run's time is the time it was played")`; every title starts `R3502000`.

- **5 minutes, left 10 hours, 5 more**
  - Start, advance 5 min, `act go`.
  - The stored run's `elapsedMs` is 300_000.
  - Dispatch `pagehide`, advance 10 h, `reload()`.
  - `elapsedMs` is 300_000 and `resumedAt` is `Date.now()`.
  - Advance 5 min, `abandon()`; `readRunHistory()[0].timeMs` is 600_000.
- **Hidden time is not counted**
  - Start, advance 2 min, `setVisibility("hidden")`.
  - The stored `elapsedMs` is 120_000 and `resumedAt` is null.
  - Advance 3 h, `setVisibility("visible")`: `elapsedMs` is still 120_000 and `resumedAt` is `Date.now()`.
  - Advance 1 min, dispatch `pagehide`: stored `elapsedMs` is 180_000.
  - Advance 1 h, `reload()`, `abandon()`: `timeMs` is 180_000.
- **A page that opens hidden counts nothing.** Seed a kept run with `elapsedMs: 60_000`, `setVisibility("hidden")`, `mount()`. `resumedAt` is null. After `setVisibility("visible")` it is `Date.now()`.
- **Leaving the page pauses.**
  - Start, advance 2 min, `cleanup()` with no store reset. The stored `elapsedMs` is 120_000.
  - Advance 1 h, `mount()` again: `elapsedMs` is 120_000.
  - Advance 1 min, `abandon()`: `timeMs` is 180_000.
- **An older kept run** (no `elapsedMs`, `startedAt` 20 h ago) loads with `elapsedMs` 0. After 1 min and an abandon, `timeMs` is 60_000. A kept run with `elapsedMs: -5` is dropped and its key removed.
- **The floor.**
  - A clock set back 1 h inside a fresh run settles with `timeMs` `DUNGEON_ELAPSED_MIN_MS` (import it from `./config.ts`).
  - After a banked 5 min, setting the clock back 1 h and abandoning still gives 300_000.
- **A settled run is not kept again.** Reuse the B20 won-run setup. After the settle, call `setVisibility("hidden")` and dispatch `pagehide`. `localStorage.getItem(DUNGEON_RUN_KEY)` is still null.

**`RunTimer.test.tsx`**

- **B24 test, new props:** `<RunTimer elapsedMs={65_000} resumedAt={T0} />` reads "Run time 1:05", and "1:08" after 3 ticks.
- **No time kept reads 0:00:** `elapsedMs={null} resumedAt={null}`.
- **`R3502000 after a reload the timer shows the kept total, then runs on`:** `elapsedMs={300_000} resumedAt={T0}` reads "5:00", then "5:02" after 2 ticks.
- **`R3502000 a paused timer holds the kept total`:** `elapsedMs={125_000} resumedAt={null}` reads "2:05" and still "2:05" after 5 ticks.

- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/dungeon`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo fmt --check`

## Done when

- [ ] A fake-clock store test: 5 min, 10 h away, 5 min settles with 10 min.
- [ ] Hidden time is not counted, and time before `pagehide` is.
- [ ] After a reload `RunTimer` shows the kept total.
- [ ] `DUNGEON_ELAPSED_MIN_MS` still floors the recorded time, and an older kept run starts at load.
- [ ] R3502000's note, tests (in `proven_in`), pending paragraph and §15.10 sentence are in place; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and eslint on `apps/web/src/dungeon` pass. The harness's fmt, clippy, cargo and `--changed` web test runs pass.

## Risks

- **Resurrecting a settled run.** A pause that rewrote `DUNGEON_RUN_KEY` for a finished run would pay it again on reload. `setSession` returns early for finished runs, and a test covers it.
- **Stale snapshot.** The first render loads with no subscriber, so the clock starts only in `subscribe`; the store commits there. A timer frame at most can lag.
- **Unclean exit.** A crash with no `pagehide` loses the time since the last save. That undercounts and never overcounts; accepted.
- **Two tabs on one run.** Each tab banks its own session and the later write wins. It is rare and undercounts; not handled.
- **Storage.** No `DUNGEON_STORAGE_VERSION` bump, because a bump would drop every kept run. `elapsedMs` is optional on read.
- **Test reloads.** `reload()` calls `cleanup()`, which pauses and banks time up to the current clock. Tests that move the clock to model a closed page must dispatch `pagehide` first.
- **Purity.** No crate changes; the generated `wire/` has no diff.

**Decisions the issue left open**
- *Start screen:* counts while the Dungeon page is open, including the start screen's Continue wait. Rejected: pausing it until Continue, which would wire `DungeonPage`'s `entered` state into the store.
- *Leaving the page:* time stops when the Dungeon page unmounts, so the "Back to Play" link, the primary leave path, stops the clock. Rejected: only hide and `pagehide`, which would time a tab left open on another route.
- *`startedAt`:* kept in storage, removed from `Dungeon`. Rejected: reusing it as a "virtual start".
- *`pageshow`:* also resumes the clock, for a back-forward-cache restore.

## Open questions

None block the build. The maintainer may prefer the start-screen wait or the Campaign's server-checked runs (§15.12) handled differently. The issue says the second "Patch" suggestion, "a dungeon run in progress survives a card patch", also edits `KeptRun`, so build the two in turn.

## Goal

`Scenario` (`crates/engine/src/testkit/scenario.rs`) gains five queries, each with its own tests in the kit:
- `events_of(kind)` and `count(kind)`, since setup;
- `last_events_of(kind)` and `last_count(kind)`, over the last step;
- `offered(seat)`, the seat's legal actions.

Every card-test copy of `count`, `fired` or `events_of` whose behaviour is exactly one of these is deleted, and its calls move to the kit. Every copy of `fn count(`, `fn fired(`, `fn events_of(` or `fn offered(` that stays gets one line saying how it differs. Only test code and docs change. So `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main` reports kind Internal, and `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes the same number of tests.

"Exact" means all three of:
- the same source: `events()` or `last_events()`;
- a filter on the event type alone;
- the same result: `usize`, or a typed `Vec<GameEvent>`.

Whether the kind is spelled as a `&str` or a `GameEventType` doesn't matter. Nor does how the type is read: `event_type()`, `matches!` on the variant, or `js(..)["type"]`.

I checked every body and call site at base `a52cde4f26`:
- **Exact (28 copies in 28 files):** 22 of the 24 `count`s, 4 of the 16 `fired`s and 2 of the 11 `events_of`s.
- **Not exact:** all 48 `offered`s. 31 of them are projections of `legal_actions`, and 17 read the open prompt or build a board.
- **Out of scope:** `added` (38) and `draws_by` (11) have no query in the proposal, so they are untouched.

`Scenario` (`crates/engine/src/testkit/scenario.rs`) gains five queries, each with its own tests in the kit:
- `events_of(kind)` and `count(kind)`, since setup;

- `offered(seat)`, the seat's legal actions.
